description: v2 protocol, frozen before any v2 training or test metric. Motivated by a validation-only probe (v1 test cells untouched by the probe): adapter quality depended mainly on the amount and spatial spread of local training RNA.
validation_and_test: identical to v1 (splits/split_seed{s}.csv.gz: 5,000 val cells, 20,000 test cells in buffered blocks)
train_pool: every cell in a 400 um block whose Chebyshev block distance to every val and test block is >= 2 (i.e. at least one full buffer block)
train_subset_rule: nested: a fixed random permutation of the pool per split seed (numpy default_rng(1000 + seed)); size N = first N cells
features: GHIST+ frozen outputs only: pred_expr_scaled*0.5 (258), occurrence_probability (258), ct_probs (9); standardised with training mean/std

methods.calibration: per-gene OLS y = a + b*p on the training cells, clipped at 0

mlp.device: mps (Apple Metal) when available, else cpu

selection_metric: validation median per-gene PCC (alpha for ridge; checkpoint for MLP)
test_metrics: same as v1, on the 20,000 test cells only. The v1 'rest' set overlaps the v2 train pool and is not used.
